reviewed: Final affected horns/tail and fur locks, front/side/rear/detail and selected run/attack/pain/lying poses; both presentation images per species; current Ao Ao regional view and overview.
qualifications: Native MD3 UV values are matched to serialized OBJ triangle ownership, then tested against the authored material cell with 1e-6 float32 tolerance; this does not establish art acceptance.
Integral grids slightly resample existing surfaces without changing their control points. Familiar and unrelated runtime resources remain byte-identical, except current diagnostic version strings.

The presentation runner retains historical sprite/model folder labels; both packages here contain native models. These are sequential pre/post repair cohorts, one700-tic pair per species; queue/tic tails do not establish display latency, repeatability, campaign/crowd performance or siege acceptance.
Existing CA787-QUADRUPEDS-01 and CA795-KASOGONAGA-01 plus CA799-UV-01 remain pending. The consolidated author terminal waits for the entire requested batch.
